additions.sourceText:
分享一波GPT-Image生成手绘工程科普信息图的提示词

提示词如下⬇️

创作一张竖版手绘工程科普信息图，主题为《[主题]的组成部分》。

背景是一张暖白色、轻微泛黄的横线笔记本纸，带浅蓝色水平横线，
纸张左侧有一条淡红色竖向页边线，保留细腻纸张纤维和轻微扫描质感。

页面顶部居中写大号蓝色圆珠笔手写标题“[中文标题]”，字体瘦长、
圆润、整洁，标题下方画一条蓝色手绘下划线。

画面中央放置一个尺寸较大的[设备名称]，采用略微俯视的四分之三
透视角度，以局部打开、剖视或拆解形式展示内部结构。结构符合真实
工程逻辑，各部件层次分明且容易辨认。

主体采用精细石墨铅笔工程插画风格：黑灰色细线勾勒，密集排线与
交叉排线塑造体积，金属表面有真实的磨砂、反光和机械纹理。整体以
灰黑色为主，仅在铜线、线路、冷却液、电缆等部位加入少量克制的
黄色、红色、蓝色彩铅点缀。保留自然的手绘线条和轻微不完美感。

在主体四周布置[数量]个编号中文标签，标签全部使用同一种蓝色
圆珠笔手写体，并用纤细的蓝色直线箭头准确指向对应部件。标签不得
遮挡设备，不要让箭头相互交叉，左右布局均衡，留白自然。

标签内容：
1. [部件名称]
2. [部件名称]
……

页面底部用同一种蓝色手写体书写2至3行简短的原理说明：
“[说明文字]”

整体效果像一名工程专业学生精心绘制的课堂笔记：技术准确、细节
丰富、写实而有手作感、版式整洁、信息清晰、自然扫描质感。

additions.sourceText:
挑战一下GPT Image2的极限，
用一个复杂的提示词测试，
生图质量还不错，可惜放大后中文字体还有些模糊

提示词图如下：

请生成一张适合作为“历史科普读物”的纵向长图海报，主题为《中国文明演变史》。

整体内容：
以时间轴方式，系统展示中国文明从“唐尧虞舜时代”开始，经过各个重要历史时期，一直到“2026年的当代中国”的演变过程。整张图要像一本高质量历史科普读物中的插图页，兼具知识性、可读性和观赏性。

画面风格：
采用经典欧洲清线漫画风格，类似《丁丁历险记》那种干净清晰的线条、平涂上色、明快复古的色彩、精致而有秩序的构图。整体像“历史百科 + 漫画分镜 + 时间轴长卷”的结合体。画风统一，具有复古知识读物和冒险漫画的感觉。

画面形式：
- 纵向长图
- 清晰的中央或侧边时间轴
- 每个历史时期用独立的小分镜 / 小场景呈现
- 每个分镜包含：
  1）时期名称
  2）对应代表性画面
  3）2到3条简洁中文知识点讲解
- 排版整齐清楚，像历史科普读物内页
- 文字简洁、清晰、易读，不要过多堆砌长段文字
- 每个历史阶段之间有明显区分，但整体过渡自然连贯

标题与说明文字：
主标题：中国文明演变史
副标题：从唐尧虞舜到2026，一张图看懂中国文明如何一步步走到今天

请包含以下历史时期，并为每个时期配上代表画面和简洁知识点：

1. 唐尧虞舜（传说时代）
画面元素：部落联盟、祭祀、农耕、河流、山川、早期聚落
知识点：
- 华夏文明的早期传说时代
- 禅让故事体现早期政治理想
- 农耕和部落联盟逐渐形成

2. 夏朝
画面元素：早期王朝、治水、礼制萌芽、原始城邑
知识点：
- 被视为中国最早的王朝之一
- 早期国家形态开始形成
- 治水传说和王权观念逐渐发展

3. 商朝
画面元素：青铜鼎、甲骨文、祭祀、王都
知识点：
- 青铜文明高度发展
- 甲骨文是早期成熟文字的重要代表
- 宗教祭祀和王权密切结合

4. 西周
画面元素：分封诸侯、礼乐制度、宗法秩序
知识点：
- 分封制和宗法制度逐渐完善
- 礼乐制度影响深远
- 为后世政治文化奠定基础

5. 春秋战国
画面元素：诸侯争霸、百家争鸣、孔子、战争与学术并存
知识点：
- 中国古代思想最活跃的时期之一
- 儒家、道家、法家等百家争鸣
- 铁器和社会变革推动历史转型

6. 秦朝
画面元素：秦始皇、长城、统一文字、郡县制、车同轨
知识点：
- 中国进入大一统帝国时代
- 统一文字、度量衡和道路制度
- 郡县制加强中央集权

7. 汉朝
画面元素：丝绸之路、驼队、宫廷、儒学、对外交流
知识点：
- 汉朝奠定了强盛帝国格局
- 丝绸之路促进中外交流
- 儒学逐渐成为主流思想

8. 三国两晋南北朝
画面元素：战乱分裂、民族融合、佛教寺庙、文人风度
知识点：
- 长期分裂，但文化持续发展
- 民族融合不断加深
- 佛教传播对思想文化影响巨大

9. 隋唐
画面元素：大运河、长安、科举、盛唐气象、丝路商旅
知识点：
- 隋朝重新统一中国
- 唐朝国力强盛、对外开放
- 科举制和长安繁荣具有代表性

10. 宋朝
画面元素：城市商业、书院、活字印刷、指南针、繁华市井
知识点：
- 商品经济和城市文化高度繁荣
- 科技发明影响深远
- 文人文化和审美高度发展

11. 元朝
画面元素：辽阔疆域、驿站、商旅往来、欧亚交流
知识点：
- 统一了更广阔的疆域
- 加强欧亚大陆之间联系
- 不同民族和文化交流更频繁

12. 明朝
画面元素：紫禁城、郑和下西洋、宝船、小说戏曲、市民社会
知识点：
- 皇权体制进一步加强
- 郑和下西洋体现航海能力
- 商品经济与文化创作活跃

13. 清朝前中期
画面元素：大一统版图、宫廷、农业社会、盛世景象
知识点：
- 版图进一步巩固
- 人口增长和农业发展明显
- 帝国秩序达到高峰

14. 清朝晚期
画面元素：鸦片战争、列强入侵、洋务运动、近代危机
知识点：
- 中国遭遇前所未有的外部冲击
- 传统秩序受到严重挑战
- 开始艰难探索近代化道路

15. 近代中国
画面元素：辛亥革命、民国城市、报刊、学生、抗战、民族觉醒
知识点：
- 中国社会进入剧烈转型阶段
- 革命、改革与救亡并行
- 民族觉醒和现代国家观念增强

16. 新中国建设时期
画面元素：开国场景、工厂、工人、农田、基础建设
知识点：
- 新中国成立后开始大规模建设
- 工业化和社会重建逐步推进
- 为现代化发展打下基础

17. 改革开放
画面元素：高楼、工厂、市场经济、沿海城市、快速发展
知识点：
- 经济体制逐步转型
- 城市化和全球化显著加快
- 中国经济实现快速增长

18. 当代中国（到2026）
画面元素：高铁、航天火箭、现代城市、互联网、AI、芯片、新能源汽车、机器人、年轻人
知识点：
- 中国持续推进科技创新和现代化建设
- 高铁、航天、数字经济和AI快速发展
- 2026年的中国呈现科技化、城市化、全球化面貌

底部总结区：
添加一个简洁总结模块，写上：
“中国文明并不是一条直线，而是在统一与分合、传承与变革中不断演进。几千年的积累，最终塑造出今天的中国。”

视觉要求：
- 每个时期的人物服饰、建筑、器物和交通工具都要有时代辨识度
- 画面精致细腻，但保持清晰简洁，不要杂乱
- 整体具有历史厚重感、知识图鉴感和冒险漫画感
- 中文必须清晰、正确、易读
- 版式像高质量历史科普读物插图页
- 整体统一、专业、美观，适合做历史科普长图海报

additions.sourceText:
Infographics of iPhone 18 pro, created using GPT Image 2.5

Prompt:

Create a premium, photorealistic 4K technology infographic showcasing the iPhone 18 Pro as the hero product.

Design a sleek, high-end editorial infographic with a minimalist Apple-inspired aesthetic, dark graphite/black background, subtle metallic gradients, soft studio reflections, and precise technical callouts.

Place a large iPhone 18 Pro vertically in the center, shown at a slight three-quarter angle with the front display and titanium-style frame clearly visible. Add a second smaller rear-angle view beside it to showcase the camera system.

Around the phone, create clean infographic callouts connected with thin elegant lines and small technical markers. Highlight key features such as:

• Pro-grade camera system
• Advanced main camera sensor
• Ultra-wide camera
• Telephoto zoom
• Next-generation A-series Pro chip
• ProMotion high-refresh-rate display
• Titanium-style premium frame
• USB-C connectivity
• Advanced computational photography
• All-day battery performance
• AI-powered photography and on-device intelligence

Use clear, modern typography, strong visual hierarchy, restrained text, and realistic technical diagrams. Include subtle exploded-view details of the camera module and internal components without making the design look cluttered.

Add a refined title at the top:

“iPHONE 18 PRO”

Subtitle:
“THE NEXT GENERATION OF PRO”

At the bottom, include a compact specification strip with categories such as:
DISPLAY • CHIP • CAMERA • BATTERY • CONNECTIVITY

Visual style: luxury technology advertising, premium product launch presentation, futuristic but believable, extremely clean composition, realistic materials, sharp details, controlled reflections, cinematic studio lighting, sophisticated black and silver palette, professional product photography, magazine-quality graphic design.

Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical
Ultra-sharp, high-resolution, photorealistic, no unnecessary decorative elements, no distorted phone geometry, no messy typography.

additions.sourceText:
opus 5.5 is insane for motion design

it made every frame of this 14s UI loop in code from one prompt

no editor. no hand-keyframes.

i'm sharing the full prompt + every follow-up for free

steal it and swap the beats for your product ↓

<inputs>
Give me:

* canvas color
* shape color
* accent color
* shape radius
* fonts
* the states the shape should morph through

Use hex codes, seconds, damping ratios and pixel sizes instead of adjectives.
</inputs>

<direction>
Make a 14 second, 1440x1440, 60fps seamless UI motion loop.

One shape, zero cuts.

The shape morphs from state to state and is never replaced.

Each state fills 50% of the frame.

The camera starts on the beat and settles slower than the shape.

Use closed-form springs.

Shape damping 0.72, settle time 0.35s.
Camera damping 1.0, settle time 0.6s.

Content swaps use 12px blur and fade over 0.15s.

The cursor tip stays locked to whatever it drags.
</direction>

<structure>
Use a 0.5s beat grid.

0.0 - pixel mascot idles
1.0 - mascot squashes into play button
1.5 - loader
2.0 - check draws
2.5 - timeline scrub
4.0 - keyframe stretches past the end and snaps back
5.0 - bezier editor
7.0 - counter rolls F 000 to F 840
8.5 - render bar fills
10.0 - command palette types "export mp4"
11.0 - toast says "840 frames rendered"
12.0 - toast shrinks back into the mascot

The last frame must be the first frame.
</structure>

<build>
Write one HTML file with Canvas 2D.

window.renderAt(t) must be a pure function of time.

No Math.random.
No clock.
No carried state.

?t= must freeze the exact moment.

Render every frame from renderAt(frame / 60).

Use 4 subframes for motion blur.

Encode to H.264 at 60fps.
</build>

<gotchas>
Fix the cursor jump at the loop wrap with:

t - 14*floor(t/14)

Do not cross-fade orange into ink.

Use a ripple from the center at 1.5s and from the click point at 12.0s.

Roll word swaps vertically.

Start draw-on after blur-in.

Aim the cursor at where the target will be when it lands.

Keep cursor speed under 65 px/frame.
</gotchas>

<start>
First show me the storyboard.

Then write the code.

After the first render, check 5 frames around every beat and fix the issues before the final render.
</start>

additions.sourceText:
I asked Opus 5.5 built a landing page for me

holy f*ck, everything you see and hear is code with one prompt

it cooked for about 5h with remotion + three.js

the key presses, springs back, then splits into labeled layers

full prompt:

Build a landing page for Detent One, a fictional mechanical keyboard, as one HTML file: 1200x675 stage, 8 s seamless loop, 60 fps. three.js 0.160 via importmap from jsDelivr; Geist and Geist Mono (Google Fonts). window.renderAt(t) draws exact time t; seeded random; no rAF loop when the URL has ?t=.

HTML UI: nav; "Press once." in Geist 800, 140px, 2 lines, tracking -0.05em, orange period; subline; black CTA "Pre-order $189"; 4 mono spec chips. Page F3F1EC, ink 111111, accent D97757.

three.js, right half: a 1u keycap in D97757 (roughness 0.45, clearcoat 0.5, dished top) on a brushed aluminum plate (anisotropy 0.8), a smoked switch with gold contacts, a black PCB with gold traces. RoomEnvironment, key and rim lights, soft contact shadows.

0-0.9 s: the key presses 4 mm, holds 8 frames, springs back (damping 0.55); the period dips with it

1.0-2.6 s: the page scrolls 675px; the camera orbits 50 degrees, pulls back 40%; the stack explodes into keycap, stem, switch, plate, PCB (0.08 s stagger); 1px leader lines and mono labels draw in.

3.3 s and 7.0 s: a light glint sweeps across.

5.2-6.8 s: it reassembles, scrolls back, headline re-reveals through masks. Grain 2%, vignette 8%.

additions.sourceText:
claude code (opus 5.5) made the product film for taxtello, my bookkeeping app

every frame is code: react + remotion, 0 after effects
the soundtrack is code too, synthesized in python from sine waves and noise

1 prompt and 2 rounds of feedback

full prompt below, steal it ↓

You are the senior motion designer, product designer and Remotion engineer for Taxtello.

Your task is to create a genuinely premium, Apple-level product film for Taxtello.

This is NOT a generic SaaS explainer.
This is NOT a feature walkthrough.
This is NOT a startup template animation.

I want a maximum 15-second brand/product showreel that makes Taxtello look like a mature, expensive, beautifully designed financial product.

Think:

Apple product launch film
× premium fintech
× editorial motion design
× restrained Stripe-like product presentation
× Taxtello's own visual identity

The desired reaction is:

“Wait, this is a German bookkeeping app?”

The film should feel expensive.

────────────────────────────────────
REPO / SOURCE OF TRUTH
────────────────────────────────────

First inspect the real repositories before designing anything.

Main product:
  /taxtello/main

Existing Remotion project:
  /taxtello/beta-motion

Important real brand sources:

  /taxtello/main/public/css/app/_00-tokens.css
  /taxtello/main/docs/design/TOKENS.md
  /taxtello/main/public/taxtello-wordmark.png
  /taxtello/main/public/icons.svg

Existing current product screenshots can be found under:

  /taxtello/main/artifacts/smoke-ui-smoke/

Prefer the newest valid screenshots/current source over stale artifacts.

There is already an existing 24-second Remotion hero animation in
/taxtello/beta-motion.

DO NOT replace it.
DO NOT regress it.
DO NOT force its current AI-connections storyline into this new film.

Create a new independent composition for this task, e.g.

  TaxtelloShowreel15

You may reuse good infrastructure, fonts, rendering utilities, motion primitives,
easing curves, asset loading and QA infrastructure from beta-motion where useful.

But creatively this should be a new film.

Before implementation, inspect the actual Taxtello UI and understand the product.

Do not invent functionality that does not exist.

────────────────────────────────────
REAL TAXTELLO VISUAL LANGUAGE
────────────────────────────────────

Use the real design system.

Core palette:

Background:
  #0c0f1a

Elevated surfaces:
  #111525
  #131722
  #1a2032

Primary brand gold:
  #e8b84b

Gold highlight:
  #f5d07a

Gold depth:
  #9b6d18

Primary text:
  #e8eaf2

Strong warm white:
  #f6f4eb

Secondary text:
  #8b93b5

Positive:
  #34d399

Negative/error only where semantically necessary:
  #f87171

Typography:
  Plus Jakarta Sans

Numbers / financial values where appropriate:
  JetBrains Mono

Use the actual Taxtello wordmark and/or Taxtello mark.
Do not redraw or approximate the logo.

Taxtello's gold should feel like a precious accent, not a yellow UI flood.

Think:
dark metal
warm gold
glass
ink
precision
quiet confidence

NOT:
cyberpunk
crypto
neon
gaming
generic AI purple
rainbow gradients

────────────────────────────────────
CORE CREATIVE RULES
────────────────────────────────────

Follow these rules ruthlessly:

1. ONE SHOT = ONE IDEA.

2. Every scene needs room to breathe.

3. The product UI is the hero.

4. Do not plaster explanatory copy everywhere.

5. Do not use hard cuts unless there is a deliberate reason.

6. Prefer object-driven transitions:
   a card becomes the next card,
   a chart line becomes a connector,
   a receipt becomes a booking,
   a number becomes another interface element,
   the camera moves through the product.

7. Use premium easing.
   No linear movement.

8. Motion should overlap naturally.
   Elements should not all start and stop at exactly the same frame.

9. Use depth sparingly:
   perspective,
   soft parallax,
   scale,
   foreground/background separation,
   controlled depth of field if achievable.

10. NO effect exists simply because it looks cool.

11. No particle spam.

12. No fake glassmorphism everywhere.

13. No excessive blur.

14. No pointless 3D spinning cards.

15. No constant zooming.

16. No 20 different animation styles.

17. No bouncing UI.

18. No giant marketing paragraph.

19. Do not imitate a particular Apple commercial shot-for-shot.
    Capture the philosophy and production quality instead.

The visual confidence should come from restraint.

────────────────────────────────────
FORMAT
────────────────────────────────────

Primary master:

1920 × 1080
60 fps
16:9
H.264
maximum duration: 15.0 seconds

Target runtime:
approximately 14.0–15.0 seconds.

It must work as a social-media product reveal even without sound.

If practical AFTER the master is finished, also create a deliberately recomposed
vertical/social variant.

Do not merely crop the desktop composition.

But the desktop master is the priority.

────────────────────────────────────
STORY / EMOTIONAL ARC
────────────────────────────────────

Do not make this a list of five features.

It should feel like one continuous thought:

CHAOS → CONTROL → CLARITY → TAXTELLO

The first 1.5 seconds must already look premium.

The first meaningful product moment should happen by ~2 seconds.

No five-second logo intro.

Possible narrative direction:

“Everything about your business, finally in one place.”

But SHOW this instead of explaining it.

I want approximately four visual ideas across the whole film.

Use the strongest REAL Taxtello surfaces you find in the repository.

Strong candidates include:

• Finanzcockpit / Dashboard
• Rechnungen
• Belege
• Bank / matching
• Steuergesundheit / tax overview

You do NOT need to show all of them.

Choose the visually strongest combination.

────────────────────────────────────
SUGGESTED 15-SECOND STORYBOARD
────────────────────────────────────

Treat this as a strong starting point, not a rigid template.

0.00 – 1.20

BLACK / NAVY.

A tiny warm-gold glint appears.

The glint elegantly reveals either the Taxtello mark or a fragment of the
wordmark.

No generic logo fade.

Think machined precision.

The camera moves through or past the mark and the UI begins to emerge from it.

Very little or no copy.

─────────────────

1.20 – 4.40

FINANCIAL CONTROL.

Reveal the actual Taxtello Cockpit as a dimensional product surface.

Not just a screenshot placed on screen.

Reconstruct/crop/layer it so individual interface regions can animate.

The hero financial number resolves crisply.
The chart draws in.
Supporting metrics settle slightly later.

Use subtle stagger.

A single line of copy may appear, for example:

  “Alles im Blick.”

or another equally short German phrase if you find something more fitting.

Maximum ~3–4 words.

The interface must remain recognizable as the real product.

─────────────────

4.40 – 7.50

DOCUMENT / BOOKKEEPING TRANSFORMATION.

Use a visual object from the previous scene as the transition.

Example:

A gold chart point expands into the corner of a receipt/card.
The camera follows it.
A receipt/document enters.
Taxtello identifies or organizes it.
The document snaps elegantly into its corresponding booking / financial record.

Use magnetic alignment and precision.

No cheesy scanner laser.

No floating paper tornado.

Possible micro-copy:

  “Belege. Erledigt.”

Only if it improves the scene.

─────────────────

7.50 – 10.70

MONEY / INVOICES.

Morph or transition naturally into the real Rechnungen interface.

Use one strong moment:

an invoice status changes,
a payment resolves,
an amount moves into place,
or the overview assembles itself.

Numbers should feel tactile and precise.

Use JetBrains Mono where this matches the actual product.

Gold highlights the active state.

Green is used only for a genuinely positive semantic state.

Potential copy:

  “Geld. Im Griff.”

Again: optional and extremely short.

─────────────────

10.70 – 12.80

TAX / CLARITY.

Transition into the real Taxtello tax-health / financial guidance surface.

Do not claim that Taxtello magically guarantees correct taxes.

Communicate visibility and control.

Example:

multiple noisy signals collapse into one calm, structured tax overview.

Potential copy:

  “Steuern im Blick.”

This scene should feel calmer than the previous scene.

The rhythm briefly slows.

─────────────────

12.80 – 15.00

BRAND PAYOFF.

Pull the camera outward.

The UI compresses or folds into one beautiful Taxtello product object / surface.

Darkness returns around it.

The gold Taxtello wordmark resolves.

One short brand line underneath.

Explore strong final lines such as:

  “Dein Business. Klar.”

  “Buchhaltung. Unter Kontrolle.”

  “Einfach mehr Überblick.”

  “Alles fürs Business. An einem Ort.”

Choose based on the actual product positioning you find in the repo.

Do not use a line simply because I suggested it.

The final frame must have enough stillness to register.

End confidently.

No giant bouncing CTA.

────────────────────────────────────
TRANSITIONS
────────────────────────────────────

This is one of the most important parts.

I want transitions that make the viewer think:

“Of course the next scene came from that.”

Good:

chart line → document edge
gold pill → invoice button
financial number → amount in invoice
card edge → next surface
camera push through interface element
shared geometry
mask reveal using actual product shapes

Bad:

crossfade
random wipe
spin transition
glitch
whip-pan every two seconds
generic SaaS slide-left
zoom-blur spam

Direct cuts are allowed only when a deliberate rhythmic impact benefits the film.

────────────────────────────────────
MOTION
────────────────────────────────────

Motion needs weight.

Use curves comparable to:

cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

where appropriate.

Different elements should have subtly different arrival times.

Prefer:

anticipation
overshoot below ~2%
settling
motion continuation
shared velocity between scenes

Avoid cartoon springiness.

Camera movement should feel like a high-end macro product shoot.

Imagine we are filming a physical premium object even though it is software.

────────────────────────────────────
LIGHTING / MATERIAL
────────────────────────────────────

Use extremely subtle environmental lighting.

Possible treatments:

• soft gold rim lighting
• dark navy falloff
• faint ambient bloom
• soft specular highlight passing across a surface
• restrained vignette
• subtle grain if it materially helps

Keep the interface crisp.

Do NOT blur the product just to look cinematic.

No fake glossy reflections that destroy legibility.

────────────────────────────────────
TYPOGRAPHY
────────────────────────────────────

Use very little copy.

No sentence should compete with the product.

Headlines should generally fit on one line.

Use Plus Jakarta Sans.

Strong typography may occasionally scale very large and become a transition
device itself.

Avoid generic motion-graphics behavior where every word animates independently.

Typography should move as designed objects.

────────────────────────────────────
SOUND / RHYTHM
────────────────────────────────────

Design the motion as if it were cut to approximately 115–120 BPM:
premium, kinetic, sophisticated, not frantic.

Important moments should land musically.

Suggested sound language:

• low soft impact for major reveal
• restrained tactile UI clicks
• subtle metallic/glass tonal tick
• soft low-frequency movement during camera transitions
• elegant resolved tone at the logo payoff

Avoid:

• huge cinematic trailer boom
• EDM risers
• loud whooshes everywhere
• stock “tech interface” sounds
• rap beat
• aggressive bass

If there is no legally safe music/audio asset in the project, DO NOT pull
copyrighted audio from the internet.

Deliver the visual master without copyrighted music and create a concise cue
sheet describing where music/SFX should hit.

If suitable safe/local audio exists, use it.

────────────────────────────────────
REAL PRODUCT ONLY
────────────────────────────────────

This is critical.

Inspect current main.

Do not invent screens.

Do not invent metrics that imply real customer data.

Use clearly synthetic/demo-safe values if required.

Do not accidentally expose any personal, test-user or production information.

Reuse the visual structure of the actual Taxtello UI.

If a screen needs to be motion-separated, recreate it faithfully in React from
the real design system instead of simply scaling a giant screenshot.

The result should still look unmistakably like Taxtello.

────────────────────────────────────
IMPLEMENTATION EXPECTATIONS
────────────────────────────────────

Work directly in:

  /taxtello/beta-motion

Create the new composition alongside the existing one.

Keep existing compositions working.

Structure the new work cleanly.

Prefer reusable primitives for:

• camera surface
• product frame
• masked transitions
• text reveals
• UI region reveals
• ambient lighting
• shared-element transitions

Avoid one 1,500-line component.

Use deterministic Remotion animation driven by frame/time.

No setTimeout.
No nondeterministic animations.

Respect 60 fps throughout.

Use interpolation/spring/easing deliberately.

────────────────────────────────────
DO NOT STOP AFTER FIRST IMPLEMENTATION
────────────────────────────────────

This is a visual task.

You MUST review the actual rendered output.

Required workflow:

1. Inspect repository and real brand/product.

2. Write a concise storyboard with:
   - exact timestamps
   - key visual
   - transition logic
   - copy
   - intended emotional rhythm

3. Implement it.

4. Run typecheck / relevant checks.

5. Render representative frames at roughly:
   0.0 s
   1.0 s
   2.5 s
   4.5 s
   6.5 s
   8.5 s
   10.5 s
   12.5 s
   14.0 s
   14.8 s

6. VISUALLY INSPECT THOSE IMAGES.

Do not merely confirm that rendering succeeded.

Ask:

Does this look like an Apple-tier product film?

Does anything look like a template?

Is there too much on screen?

Is the product legible?

Are transitions logically connected?

Does Taxtello gold feel premium?

Does every frame look composed?

7. Fix visual weaknesses.

8. Render the complete film.

9. Inspect multiple exact decoded frames from the final MP4, not only browser
   screenshots.

10. Iterate again if necessary.

Do not declare success because the code compiles.

The deliverable is the FILM.

────────────────────────────────────
QUALITY BAR
────────────────────────────────────

Reject your own result if it feels like:

• a SaaS template
• a PowerPoint animation
• a website screen recording
• a generic Remotion demo
• a crypto advertisement
• an AI-generated promo template
• five screenshots sliding around
• excessive marketing copy

Every important frame should be good enough to use as a still advertisement.

I would rather have:

3 extraordinary visual moments

than

10 mediocre feature animations.

────────────────────────────────────
FINAL DELIVERABLES
────────────────────────────────────

Provide:

1. Final storyboard
2. New Remotion composition source
3. 1920×1080 / 60fps final MP4
4. Poster/final frame
5. Contact sheet with representative frames from the film
6. Exact runtime
7. List of real Taxtello assets/screens used
8. Brief explanation of the motion language
9. Any remaining visual compromises
10. Commands to reproduce the render

Save outputs in a clearly named directory such as:

  /taxtello/beta-motion/out/showreel-15/

Do not deploy anything.
Do not modify production data.
Do not merge anything.

Go all out creatively, but exercise ruthless restraint.

Make Taxtello look expensive.

GPT image 2

Prompt:
Create a clean, child-friendly educational vocabulary poster for preschool/kindergarten children, inspired by a simple visual learning card.

Feature [FRUIT] as the main large realistic object on the left, and show a [PART / SLICE / SEGMENT] of the same fruit on the right. Connect the two with a playful dotted curved arrow and a tiny simple stick-figure child pointing toward the smaller part.

Add the word “[FRUIT NAME]” in large bold uppercase letters at the top and “[PART NAME]” in large bold uppercase letters underneath the smaller image. Use a soft white and very light pastel-blue background, rounded image panels, clean spacing, realistic fruit photography, simple blue typography, and minimal playful illustrations.

The overall design should feel bright, educational, modern, uncluttered, and easy for young children to understand, like a premium preschool vocabulary learning card. Vertical 4:5 composition, high resolution, soft lighting, clear labels, no unnecessary decorations.

📋 GPT Image 2 : Storyboard Prompt

Create a crisp, clean infographic storyboard poster for THE FIREFIGHTER. Wide 16:9 layout, white background, black borders, bold black typography, premium Pixar 3D stylized rendering, intense dramatic colors — fiery deep oranges, emergency red, smoke charcoal grays, bright helmet yellows, heroic steel blues.

Top header:
THE FIREFIGHTER
TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 15 SECONDS
8 SHOTS · INTENSE · HEROIC · POWERFUL
Legend icons: ACTION, DANGER, TIME HINT, GEAR

Same Pixar-style firefighter throughout: strong brave young woman, full turnout gear, yellow helmet, urban fire station and city street setting, dramatic emergency lighting.

8 panels:
→ Alarm sounds — firefighter leaps from bunk, alarm light flashes red, station erupts into action
→ Gearing up — turnout pants pulled on, jacket zipped, helmet snapped on in rapid fluid motion
→ Down the pole — slides down fire pole with speed and precision, lands perfectly ready
→ Engine rolls — fire truck bursts through station doors, lights blazing, siren screaming into city
→ Arrives at scene — truck stops, smoke pouring from building, firefighter jumps out focused and calm
→ Hose deployed — heavy hose shouldered, valve cranked open, powerful water stream erupts out
→ Into the smoke — firefighter pushes through smoke and heat, mask on, fearless and determined
→ Rescue complete — emerges from building carrying survivor, colleagues cheer, sunrise breaking behind

Footer:
VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 15 seconds. Alarm to rescue.
CAMERA TIPS: close-up on gear snap, hose water eruption, and final sunrise rescue, wide on fire scene arrival, dramatic low angle on engine rolling out
LIGHT & STYLE: dramatic emergency lighting, fiery deep oranges, emergency reds, smoke charcoal grays, heroic steel blues, shallow depth of field, Pixar vivid heroic colors
FIREFIGHTER NOTES: one firefighter, one rescue, one heroic moment. Intense, powerful, deeply inspiring.

复拍教程最容易漏掉的，不是构图线，而是相机到底站在哪里。
🗺️ top-view diagram with subject position, camera position, direction arrow, and distance range
这样，读者能一眼看懂自己该站在人物正前、侧前还是斜前；距离也不再靠猜。
📐 side-view diagram showing camera height and tilt-angle range
同一个姿势，机位高一点就会显头大腿短。把相机离地高度和仰俯角画出来，才能把照片里的比例真正复拍出来。

GPT- image 2 prompt👇
把【图1参考图】作为唯一视觉依据，生成一张竖版 3:4 的街拍摄影知识分析图（教学信息图海报）。目标：用清晰有趣的图示把“人物位置、相机位置、镜头/距离、机位高度、拍摄角度、构图要点”讲明白，达到教别人复拍的目的。整体风格：干净高级的摄影教程信息图 + 轻手账式标注；浅米白纸感底或浅灰底；黑白灰为主；从图1自动提取1–2个颜色作为点缀；线条清晰、信息密度高但不杂乱、排版对齐统一、可读性强。

强制规则：
- 必须保留图1的：人物姿势、人物与环境的相对位置关系、主要背景结构线条、光影方向与空间逻辑
- 不改变姿势、不改场景，只做“分析图示化呈现”
- 人脸不作为重点：可轻度虚化/简化，不做写实美颜，不强化五官
- 全中文；不要英文、不要品牌名、不要水印、不要UI界面元素

固定版式（每次都一样，不随图1改变）：
1）主视觉区（上半区或左侧大图）：放置“参考画面展示”（基于图1轻度风格化/插画化，但场景与姿态可辨识），叠加：三分法网格、主体轮廓框、引导线提示、垂直线/水平线校正提示；用编号圆点+手绘箭头标注关键点（主体落点、留白方向、腿部延伸方向、背景引导线来源）。
2）示意图区（右侧或下半区，两张并列）：
- 俯视平面图（Top View）：用极简图标画出墙面/街道/建筑边线（从图1抽象），人物站位（小人图标），相机站位（相机图标）；必须显示拍摄方向箭头、人物与相机距离（虚线+数值范围）、推荐站位点A/B（两个备选点位）；相机方位必须与图1一致（正前/侧前/斜前等）。
- 侧视高度图（Side View）：画出地面线、人物高度示意、相机高度示意、仰俯角扇形；必须显示相机离地高度范围（按图1推断给出合理区间）、镜头仰俯角范围（按图1推断给出合理区间）；低机位/平视/高机位必须正确。
3）参数卡片区（底部三张圆角卡片固定）：
- 卡片1：镜头与距离（给出等效焦段建议范围 + 拍摄距离建议范围）
- 卡片2：相机高度与角度（给出相机高度范围 + 仰俯角范围）
- 卡片3：姿势与肢体要点（用短句总结图1姿势的可复拍要点）
4）错误示范区（右下角固定）：3条红叉错误提示（根据图1自动生成最相关的3条，短句化），例如：不要超广角贴脸、不要裁切脚尖/手指、不要机位过高导致比例失真（按图1实际情况自动调整）。

自动推断要求（让它每次替换图1都能用）：
- 从图1自动推断并写入图示：相机方位、机位高低、拍摄距离区间、等效焦段区间、主体落点与裁切策略、背景引导线来源
- 所有数值用“范围”表达（可信、可复拍），不要给单一死数

输出要求：
高清、线条锐利、阴影自然、图标统一、排版整齐、信息可读；无乱码文字、无Logo、无水印、无多余装饰。

负面限制：
不要水印、不要Logo、不要英文、不要乱码、不要过度写实人脸、不要夸张卡通比例、不要肢体畸变/多手指、不要杂乱排版、不要低清晰度、不要厚重滤镜、不要改变图1人物姿势与场景关系。

#月曜日から日曜日
あっという間に一週間が終わる無限ループを再現してみました

✅️作り方
Nano Banana Pro で画像参照して下記プロンプトをコピペ。各曜日の表現は自由に変えてOK！

---プロンプト---
【キャラクター参照指定】
参照画像のキャラクターを必ず使用する。
すべてのコマで同一人物として描写すること。
顔立ち・髪型・目の形・雰囲気を完全に一致させる。
別人化、顔の変化、髪型変更は禁止。
服装は曜日ごとに変えてよいが、キャラ自体は同一。
デフォルメしても「参照画像の人物」と一目でわかること。

【全体コンセプト】
月曜日から日曜日までの1週間を表現した、
完全な円形のアニメイラスト。

【構図・レイアウト】
・円全体を「必ず7分割」したピザカット構図
・6分割や12分割は禁止
・正確に7つの等しい扇形
・インフォグラフィック風レイアウト
・7コマすべてが自然につながる構成

【曜日の順番（厳守・時計回り）】
MONDAY → TUESDAY → WEDNESDAY → THURSDAY → FRIDAY → SATURDAY → SUNDAY → MONDAYへ戻る

【循環表現】
・円の外周に太めの循環矢印を配置
・時計回り
・1週間が無限に繰り返されていることを強調

【キャラクターデザイン】
・強くデフォルメされたコミカルなアニメキャラ
・ちびキャラ体型
・頭が大きく体が小さい
・手足が短い
・表情は極端でギャグ寄り
・可愛く誇張されたリアクション

【テキストルール】
・各コマに英語の曜日文字のみを配置
「MONDAY」「TUESDAY」「WEDNESDAY」「THURSDAY」
「FRIDAY」「SATURDAY」「SUNDAY」
・セリフ、吹き出し、日本語文字は一切入れない
・曜日文字は太く、読みやすく、歪みなし
・各コマの形に沿って配置

【各曜日の描写】

MONDAY：
スーツ姿のデフォルメOL。
ボサボサ髪、死んだ目。
大きなコーヒーを2本持っている。

TUESDAY：
無表情でパソコン作業。
自分より高い書類の山に囲まれている。

WEDNESDAY：
夜遅くまで残業。
暗いオフィス、窓の外は夜景。
ぐったりした姿勢で疲労困憊。

THURSDAY：
口から魂が抜けているコミカル表現。
透明でかわいい魂が体から浮かび上がっている。
極限の疲労をギャグとして描写。

FRIDAY：
ハイテンションな表情。
ジャケットを脱ぎ、
泡があふれる大きなビールジョッキを持っている。
お祭りのような雰囲気。

SATURDAY：
私服姿で友人と楽しくお出かけ。
元気いっぱいで跳ねるようなポーズ。
明るくにぎやかな空気。

SUNDAY：
ベッドに倒れ込むように寝転がっている。
スマホ画面に「MONDAY」の文字が見えている。
大げさに絶望している。

【画風・品質】
・デフォルメ強めのコミカルアニメ調
・太めの線画
・シンプルな影
・明るくポップな配色
・表情が非常に分かりやすい
・高品質イラスト

【ネガティブ指定】
・リアル調、写実的表現
・キャラクターの顔・髪型の変化
・7分割以外の構図
・曜日順の乱れ
・日本語曜日表記
・セリフ、吹き出し
・文字の崩れ、歪み
・四角いコマ割り

additions.sourceText:
Nano Banana Pro (Gemini) で使える、ChatGPT v5.1 vs v5.2 の進化図解プロンプトを作りました！🍌✨

推しキャラや自分のアバター画像を
「画像参照」にセットするだけで、
その子が解説してくれる可愛い比較図が作れます。

v5.1の「温かい対話」と、v5.2の「ガチ性能アップ」の違いが一目でわかるように設計しました。ぜひ試してみてください！👇

【コピペ用プロンプト】
（使い方：Geminiの画像生成画面で、登場させたい画像を1枚アップロードしてから、下のテキストを貼り付けて実行してください）

可愛くて遊び心のある、コミカルな漫画スタイルのインフォグラフィック図解イラスト。画面を左右に分割した比較図で、上部に大きなタイトル「ChatGPTの進化：v5.1 (基礎) vs v5.2 (強化)」と書かれている。

左半分は「v5.1：温かい対話と基礎の確立」というタイトル。背景は居心地の良い、整理されたカフェのような部屋。アップロードされた参照画像のキャラクター（または人物）がここに描写され、リラックスした笑顔で、友好的な丸いロボットと湯気の立つお茶を飲みながら自然に会話を楽しんでいる。手元には「応答トーン：Friendly/Pro」と書かれたカスタムダイヤルがある。周囲には温かい色のキーワードが浮かぶ：「自然で温かい会話」「パーソナライズ」「快適な追従性」。

中央には「進化の土台」と書かれた矢印があり、右側が左側をベースにしていることを示している。

右半分は「v5.2：正確性・パワーの大幅強化」というタイトル。左側の部屋を土台にして拡張された、未来的で巨大なハイテク研究ラボ。同じ参照画像のキャラクター（または人物）が、自信満々な表情でここに描写され、ハイテクな分析ゴーグルをかけている。山のように巨大な巻物（長文ドキュメント）を広げ、空中に浮かぶ複雑なグラフや画像を正確にスキャンし、複数の機械アームを使ってバリバリ作業をこなしている。周囲には力強く鮮やかな色のキーワードが浮かぶ：「正確性UP（嘘激減！）」「超長文コンテキスト理解」「深い推論力(xhigh)」「高度な画像理解」。

全体的に、左側が快適な日常、右側が頼りになるプロフェッショナルなパワー、という対比が可愛らしく表現されている。

步骤：1、上传图片，粘贴prompt➡️

prompt👇
角色设定：你是一位精通美食摄影与视觉设计的AI提示词工程师。任务：请分析我上传的美食图片，识别菜品名称、主要食材、烹饪逻辑和大致热量。
输出：请严格按照以下【通用提示词模板】格式，填充分析出的具体内容，生成一段用于AI绘画的提示词。
【通用提示词模板】
超干净的现代风食谱信息图。以极具吸引力的成品形态展示[这里填入分析出的菜品名称]，画面略带悬浮感，使用透视或倾斜视角。将食材、步骤与小贴士围绕主菜进行动态编辑式排版，不局限于俯视角。
核心指令 (Language)：图中所有文字、标签、步骤说明必须严格使用“简体中文”显示。
1. 食材区：
为每种食材（[这里填入分析出的5-8种主要食材列表]）配以图标或迷你插画，并用中文标注用量。以分组、列表或环形流线的方式排列，通过视觉连线与主菜相连。
2. 步骤区：
用编号面板（1, 2, 3...）、箭头或线条展示制作流程（[这里填入推测的3-4个关键烹饪步骤]），在主菜周围形成清晰的逻辑动线。
3. 补充信息（可选）：
用中文标注：总热量（[估算卡路里]）、准备时间（[估算时间]）、烹饪时间（[估算时间]）、份量、辣度等，以简洁气泡或徽章形式呈现在主菜附近。
4. 视觉风格：
编辑级信息图融合生活方式美食摄影。食物色彩鲜亮自然，搭配轻微投影、干净的矢量图标、现代无衬线字体（中文黑体风格）。步骤面板可使用柔和渐变或玻璃拟态效果。强调色用于突出关键信息。
5. 构图指南：
成品菜肴作为视觉核心，采用透视或倾斜角度；
食材与步骤围绕主菜动态流动；
层级清晰：主菜 > 步骤 > 食材 > 可选数据；
保留充足留白，整体轻盈、易读。
6. 光影与背景：
柔和自然的棚拍光线，极简纹理或渐变背景，营造高级编辑感。
7. 输出规格：
1080×1080，超清锐利，适配社交流水线展示，无水印。
